evidence_quotes.quid_pro_quo: Not present. Calvin jumps directly into 'I just wanted to ask a couple of quick questions... are we going to be moving the Washer/Dryer and fridge' with no time-box framing or promise of a dependable quote.
evidence_quotes.their_agenda: Not asked. Calvin never asks 'Other than price, what are your biggest concerns?' He moves straight into appliance questions and logistics.
evidence_quotes.estimate_anchor: No estimate given. Calvin says 'we're time based and we bill in fifteen minute increments' but never anchors a price range or personalizes it to this customer's move. No dollar figure or typical-range offered.
evidence_quotes.pricing_framing: Partial. Calvin mentions 'time based,' '15 minute increments,' and 'you only pay for the supply, packing supplies we actually use and the time over, the minimum that we actually use' — but no trip fee, overnight fee, or '2.5-hour minimum' commitment framing, and no 'not a guess' language.
evidence_quotes.feels_fair_then_silence: Not asked. No version of 'Does that feel fair?' Calvin never seeks explicit buy-in on pricing.
evidence_quotes.on_time_guarantee_delivered: None. No mention of On-Time Guarantee or any discount terms.
evidence_quotes.damage_coverage_delivered: None. No mention of No Worries Damage Coverage, $2,000 coverage, or deductible language.
evidence_quotes.final_concerns_check: Throwaway. Calvin asks 'did you have any questions or any other concerns for me at the moment?' — generic and empty, not a genuine 'What's still concerning you about this move?'
evidence_quotes.explicit_ask: Never asked. Calvin never asks 'Would you like our help with your move?' The call ends with 'I'll send this over and have a great day' — a confirmation of next steps, not an explicit close.

top_strength: Calvin successfully gathered key logistics details (moving dates, appliances, bunk bed disassembly, no elevator at destination, third-floor walk-up, on-site vs. off-site haul) and confirmed the delivery address, showing active listening to the customer's repeated emphasis on downsizing.
coaching_note: This call skipped the entire opening frame (quid pro quo, Section 1), never asked for the customer's agenda or concerns (Section 2), never quoted a price or delivered either of the Two Promises (Sections 4 and 5), and never closed with an explicit ask for the business (Section 7) — it functioned as a logistics-confirmation call only, not a complete sales call.
